sources.title: shootthesound/Fizgig: Krea 2, MiniMax & Klein 9B LoRA - GitHub
sources.snippet: Dataset prep AI captioning with the captioner that trains your model — Krea 2's Qwen3-VL writes viewpoint-aware training captions in five editable preset styles (including Style, which describes everything except the look so your trigger word binds to it). Every preset's instruction is editable in plain English and persists.
